description: Plant honeytoken secrets where no legitimate agent should look; get an instant alert with a full trace the moment one is touched.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; re-targeted to the real shared/kit.js contract.

notes.note: Booby-trapping secrets agents must never touch is a genuinely clever tripwire idea. But per-canary-per-month is a pricing model in search of a budget — this is a feature inside Vault/Akeyless/a secrets manager, not a company. Weakest assumption: a CISO signs a contract for tripwires rather than asking their existing secrets vendor to add it.
Auto trip-alert fires on load (magic moment); dismiss/rotate/isolate + sim-grab all work; zero errors.

notes.change: Trips persist as incidents with triage checklist (rotate/isolate/notify) and copyable incident report; modal actions check off triage steps instead of toasting; live feed heartbeat.
